description: This file defines an internal implementation of an inlined vector container within the Abseil C++ library, including templates for storage management, iterators, and policies for efficient memory operations.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: A template class managing inline and heap storage for a vector-like container, with methods for initialization, resizing, insertion, erasure, reservation, and swapping.

classes.name: IteratorValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for constructing or assigning values from an iterator.

classes.name: CopyValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for copying values from a pointer.

classes.name: StorageView
classes.description: A simple struct representing a view into storage with data pointer, size, and capacity.

methods.name: DestroyContents
methods.description: Destroys all elements and deallocates storage if allocated.

methods.name: InitFrom
methods.description: Initializes storage from another storage instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes storage with a set of values and a new size.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new values to storage, resizing as needed.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes storage, constructing or destroying elements as necessary.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts elements at a specified position.

methods.name: EmplaceBack
methods.description: Constructs and adds a new element at the end.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for at least the requested size.

methods.name: ShrinkToFit
methods.description: Reduces capacity to fit the current size.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another storage instance.
